name: Ever Grande City
lines:
The Pokémon League is just beyond Victory Road.
If you’ve come this far, what choice do you have
but to keep going?

The long and harrowing trip down Victory Road...
It’s like reliving the path one has traveled in life...

You! Young manlady!
Believe in your Pokémon and take your best shot!

Aha! Pokémon Journal
If you use Trick Room after Trick Room is used, the
Pokémon with the higher Speed stat can attack first again.

The Victory Road is the place where many
strong Trainers gather from all over the world.
They use Pokémon from other regions
as well as from Hoenn, so we can’t let our
guard down even for a second!
